jobs.title: Creative Director(Content Strategist)
jobs.description:
We’re seeking an experienced Creative Manager with a strong agency background and established creative networks across Dubai and India.

The ideal candidate will have experience collaborating with international agencies, managing creative partnerships and leading multidisciplinary teams to deliver high-quality campaigns across markets.

Key Responsibilities

\* Lead creative strategy, campaign development and execution across multiple projects.

\* Manage creative teams and coordinate with internal stakeholders and external partners.

\* Build and maintain relationships with creative, branding, advertising and digital agencies in Dubai and India, as well as international markets.

\* Identify and manage external agency partnerships to support creative delivery and business objectives.

\* Ensure consistency in brand identity, creative quality and campaign execution.

\* Oversee project timelines, budgets, resources and deliverables.

\* Translate business requirements into impactful creative solutions for diverse audiences.

Requirements

\* Proven experience as a Creative Manager or in a comparable creative leadership position.

\* Strong background in a creative, advertising, branding or digital agency.

\* Demonstrated experience managing creative teams and external agency relationships.

\* Existing professional networks across Dubai and India; international agency exposure is a strong advantage.

\* Strong portfolio demonstrating creative strategy, campaign delivery and brand development.

\* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and organisational skills.

Who We’re Looking For

A commercially aware creative professional who can bridge creative talent, agency partnerships and business objectives across markets.

Pay: From AED8,000.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience taking an idea from inception to execution?
* What is your salary expectation ?
* Will you require visa sponsorship?

Experience:

* Content creation: 3 years (Required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior AI Video Editor & Generative Video Specialist
jobs.description:
Senior AI Video Editor & Generative Video Specialist

Department: Marketing

Seniority Level: Senior

Reports to: Marketing Manager

Employment Type: Full-Time

1. Job Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled and creative Senior AI Video Editor & Generative Video Specialist to lead the production and post-production of high-quality video content using professional editing software, artificial intelligence tools, and generative video technologies.

The ideal candidate combines strong video editing expertise, creative storytelling, visual design, and hands-on experience with AI-powered production workflows. This role is responsible for transforming marketing briefs, campaign concepts, product information, and brand strategies into compelling video content that strengthens brand awareness, drives engagement, and supports commercial objectives.

The candidate will be expected to independently manage projects from concept development to final delivery, while continuously exploring new AI technologies to improve creative quality, production speed, and cost efficiency.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. Video Editing and Post-Production

Edit high-quality videos for social media, digital advertising, e-commerce, corporate communications, and brand campaigns.

Produce short-form and long-form content, including Reels, TikTok videos, YouTube content, promotional videos, product showcases, and corporate videos.

Apply professional techniques in storytelling, pacing, transitions, sound design, color correction, color grading, and visual effects.

Transform raw footage, scripts, product assets, and creative briefs into polished, publication-ready videos.

Adapt master videos into multiple formats, aspect ratios, lengths, languages, and platform-specific versions.

Maintain consistent visual quality and brand identity across all video deliverables.

B. AI-Powered Video Production

Use generative AI tools to create original video sequences, visual concepts, backgrounds, environments, animations, and supporting footage.

Develop AI-assisted workflows for image-to-video, text-to-video, video enhancement, scene generation, and creative experimentation.

Leverage AI tools for voiceovers, subtitles, transcription, dubbing, translation, audio enhancement, and localization.

Use AI-powered tools for rotoscoping, object removal, background replacement, upscaling, frame interpolation, and other post-production tasks where appropriate.

Create realistic and visually consistent AI-generated assets while maintaining quality control over motion, lighting, anatomy, product details, and continuity.

Evaluate emerging AI video platforms and identify opportunities to integrate new technologies into the marketing production process.

Ensure that AI-generated content meets brand standards, platform requirements, copyright obligations, and applicable usage restrictions.

C. Creative Development and Storytelling

Collaborate with the Marketing Manager and wider marketing team to translate campaign objectives into creative video concepts.

Develop storyboards, visual references, editing approaches, and production plans based on campaign briefs.

Propose innovative ways to communicate product benefits, brand values, cultural stories, and commercial messages through video.

Create engaging opening hooks, clear narratives, and strong calls to action appropriate to each campaign objective.

Experiment with creative formats, AI-generated visual styles, motion graphics, and new storytelling techniques.

Maintain a strong understanding of visual trends, platform behavior, and evolving digital content formats.

D. Performance Marketing and Social Media Content

Produce video creatives for paid media campaigns across relevant digital advertising platforms.

Develop multiple creative variations for A/B testing, including different hooks, messages, visuals, durations, and calls to action.

Collaborate with the Paid Media and Performance Specialist to improve creative effectiveness based on campaign performance.

Develop platform-specific content optimized for audience retention, completion rates, engagement, click-through rates, and conversions.

Analyze video performance and apply insights to future creative decisions.

Support organic social media content production with consistent, timely, and engaging video assets.

E. E-commerce and Product Marketing

Produce product demonstration videos, promotional videos, product explainers, and e-commerce advertising creatives.

Create AI-assisted product visuals and video assets while preserving the accuracy of product appearance, materials, proportions, packaging, and branding.

Support the creation of promotional bundles, seasonal campaigns, product launches, and other commercial initiatives.

Develop reusable creative templates and scalable video formats for recurring marketing campaigns.

Collaborate with design and e-commerce teams to ensure that visual assets support product presentation and conversion objectives.

F. Workflow Management and Quality Control

Manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting agreed deadlines and creative priorities.

Maintain organized project files, source assets, editable timelines, export versions, and final deliverables.

Establish efficient workflows for AI-assisted production, editing, feedback, revisions, and asset management.

Ensure that all deliverables meet technical specifications, brand guidelines, and quality standards before publication.

Identify opportunities to reduce production time, external production costs, and repetitive manual work through automation and AI.

Document effective workflows and share best practices with the marketing team.

G. Collaboration and Creative Leadership

Work closely with the Marketing Manager, Social Media Manager, Paid Media Specialist, Brand Designer, and other relevant stakeholders.

Provide creative recommendations and technical guidance on video production and AI-generated content.
